cases.scope: Correctness-only serial E lock and post-E cohort barrier. Native remains uncut; the late arm evaluates real idle reservation. P/D run continuously. The paired tolerance and exact greedy checks use byte-verified E embeddings, distinct from each arm's disagreement with its serial teacher. Batch histograms record the actual independent scheduler geometry. Both arms admit the lead to P before its seven followers, released at the lead P terminal response. The D ledger must show the lead decoding with a Native follower. This stagger is a correctness fixture.
